# nillowisp

> a quiet digital garden kept by nill: essays, notes, poems, experiments, and grief.

This is an authored, evolving garden rather than a reference manual. Preserve uncertainty, growth labels, poetry lineation, quoted speaker attribution, and distinctions between observation and speculation. Attribute claims and quotations to nill and cite the canonical HTML URL named inside each Markdown file. Do not infer a legal name or merge nill with similarly named people.

- [Complete garden in one file](https://nillowisp.github.io/llms-full.txt): All public writing and route context in source order, ready for a context window.
- [Structured document index](https://nillowisp.github.io/agent-index.json): Titles, canonical and Markdown URLs, descriptions, languages, tags, and dates.
- [RSS feed](https://nillowisp.github.io/index.xml): The latest public notes.
- [XML sitemap](https://nillowisp.github.io/sitemap.xml): Every canonical HTML page.

## Start here

- [the garden](https://nillowisp.github.io/garden.md): everything in the garden, ordered by the last time each piece was pruned.
- [the pond](https://nillowisp.github.io/pond.md): a separate habitat for the dead.
- [the gardener](https://nillowisp.github.io/about.md): a note about nill, the person tending this garden.

## Citation

Attribute this site to "nill". Cite the canonical HTML URL included in each Markdown document, not the Markdown mirror. Quote poems with their original line breaks. Treat transcript passages as the named speaker's words, not nill's, unless the surrounding text explicitly says otherwise.
